title: Ninety: forecast movement
description: What the forecast changed its mind about.

items.title: Serie A: 1 club moved
items.content_text: Venezia's relegation risk fell from 36% to 29%.

items.title: Bundesliga: 2 clubs moved
items.content_text: Schalke 04's relegation risk fell from 54% to 44%. SV Elversberg's relegation risk rose from 15% to 22%.

items.title: Primeira Liga: 8 clubs moved
items.content_text: Marítimo's relegation risk fell from 43% to 19%. Académico de Viseu's relegation risk fell from 44% to 23%. Estrela da Amadora's relegation risk rose from 26% to 34%. Rio Ave's relegation risk rose from 23% to 31%. Casa Pia's relegation risk rose from 21% to 28%.

items.title: Championship: 6 clubs moved
items.content_text: West Ham United's title chance rose from 47% to 62%. Middlesbrough's qualification chance fell from 35% to 21%. Cardiff City's relegation risk fell from 22% to 11%. Wolverhampton Wanderers's qualification chance rose from 20% to 30%. Burnley's qualification chance rose from 20% to 29%.
